## Proposed changes

Describe the big picture of your changes here.

## Types of changes

_Put an `x` in the boxes that apply_

- [ ] Bugfix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (if none of the other choices apply)
- [ ] Chore (dependency updates, CI config, refactoring)

## Checklist

_Put an `x` in the boxes that apply_

- [ ] Site builds successfully (`npm run build`)
- [ ] HTML validates cleanly (`npm run validate`)
- [ ] Tested locally in both light and dark themes
- [ ] Checked on mobile viewport
- [ ] I have updated documentation if appropriate

## Further comments

If this is a relatively large or complex change, explain why you chose the solution you did and what alternatives you considered.
